Use case: stylized-concept. Deliver a bitmap material asset for a semi-illustrated late-1980s VHS video-library web interface. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target: match its petroleum blue-black painted metal, thin antique brass wear and crafted shallow depth. Do not reproduce the screen, brand, text, posters, films, interface, furniture or people. This is a functional asset to assemble behind live HTML. No lettering, icons, watermark or baked checkerboard. No photoreal room, brick wall, marble, fabric, leather, sci-fi parts, chrome, neon glow or strong lighting vignette. Keep the tactile painted finish of the reference, not a smooth generic gradient.
Asset type: seamless base material texture, opaque square, full bleed. Produce a square 1024x1024 tiling texture of ONLY the common blue-black PAINTED METAL SURFACE visible between openings in the reference. Even face-on diffuse albedo; same luminance at all four edges and across field. Fine paint grain, small irregular muted bronze chips and short rubbed scuffs dispersed sparsely, like the reference; mostly intact dark petrol paint. Tiny warm marks, not large gold islands or high-contrast cracks. Flat material without any panel, rim, screw, aperture, object, border, bevel or center of interest. Seamless horizontal and vertical edge matching. No macro mottled clouds, directionally lit corners or large gradient. Show actual fine material texture throughout, at a scale suitable behind readable small UI labels. The entire square is one uninterrupted surface.
